mapper.sql: select r.rule_id, r.site_code, r.rule_no, r.metric_code, r.owner_user_id, r.judge_type, r.warn_low, r.warn_high, r.crit_low, r.crit_high, r.period_hours, r.duration_count, r.escalate_hours, r.mute_hours, r.min_sample_key, r.min_sample_value, r.notify_chat_id, r.notify_chat_name, r.enabled, r.paused_at, r.last_notified_at, r.last_judged_at, r.judge_error, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, c.metric_name, c.value_format, c.value_decimals, case when r.min_sample_key = 'base' then '基准' else coalesce(sc.metric_name, r.min_sample_key) end as min_sample_label, u.email as owner_email, coalesce(u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0', false) as owner_valid, coalesce(ch.name, r.notify_chat_name) as chat_name, ch.status as chat_status, cu.email as create_by_email, mu.email as update_by_email, e.last_trigger_hour from monitor_rule r left join dashboard_metric_card c on c.metric_code = r.metric_code left join dashboard_metric_card sc on sc.metric_code = r.min_sample_key left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_user_id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_name = r.create_by and cu.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user mu on mu.user_name = r.update_by and mu.del_flag = '0' left join monitor_lark_chat ch on ch.site_code = r.site_code and ch.chat_id = r.notify_chat_id left join (select ev.rule_id, max(ev.trigger_hour) as last_trigger_hour from monitor_event ev where ev.site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and ev.event_type = 'alert' group by ev.rule_id) e on e.rule_id = r.rule_id
mapper.select: select r.metric_code, r.rule_no, u.email as owner_email from monitor_rule r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_user_id where r.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_rule ( site_code, rule_no, metric_code, owner_user_id, judge_type, warn_low, warn_high, crit_low, crit_high, period_hours, duration_count, escalate_hours, mute_hours, min_sample_key, min_sample_value, notify_chat_id, notify_chat_name, enabled, paused_at, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{siteCode}, #{ruleNo}, #{metricCode}, #{ownerUserId}, #{judgeType}, #{warnLow,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{warnHigh,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{critLow,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{critHigh,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{periodHours}, #{durationCount}, #{escalateHours,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, #{muteHours}, #{minSampleKey}, #{minSampleValue}, #{notifyChatId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notifyChatName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{enabled}, #{pausedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update: update monitor_rule set owner_user_id = #{rule.ownerUserId}, warn_low = #{rule.warnLow,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, warn_high = #{rule.warnHigh,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, crit_low = #{rule.critLow,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, crit_high = #{rule.critHigh,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, period_hours = #{rule.periodHours}, duration_count = #{rule.durationCount}, escalate_hours = #{rule.escalateHours,jdbcType=SMALLINT}, mute_hours = #{rule.muteHours}, min_sample_value = #{rule.minSampleValue}, notify_chat_id = #{rule.notifyChatId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, notify_chat_name = #{rule.notifyChatName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_by = #{rule.updateBy}, update_time = #{rule.updateTime} where rule_id = #{rule.ruleId} and site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from monitor_rule r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.enabled = true
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_rule_state (rule_id, site_code, run_start_hour, recent_levels, recent_periods, open_event_id, last_period_end, last_data_hour, update_time) values (#{ruleId}, #{scope.siteCode}, null, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, null, null, #{lastDataHour,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{now}) on conflict (rule_id) do update set run_start_hour = null, recent_levels = '[]'::jsonb, recent_periods = '[]'::jsonb, last_period_end = null, last_data_hour = excluded.last_data_hour, update_time = excluded.update_time where monitor_rule_state.site_code = excluded.site_code
